extraction.notes: Quarter ended Dec 31, 2025 column. EQR reports no AFFO metric, so affo_total is null and recurring capex is not applicable (the only capex table on page 26 is full-year 2025). The printed 'FFO' line (377,168) is before preferred distributions; I used 'FFO available to Common Shares and Units' (376,813) as the FFO subtotal because preferred distributions (-355) appear in the adjustments from net income, and the core subtotal is 'Normalized FFO available to Common Shares and Units' (399,945). Preferred distributions were categorized as 'other'. 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' (2,940 in core adjustments) was categorized as 'other' since its nature is not specified. Per-share checks: 376,813/388,748 = 0.97; 399,945/388,748 = 1.03. Premium on redemption of preferred shares and NCI share of gain on sales are dashes in Q4 2025 and omitted.
